leadText:
The following is a list of volumes of the Pokémon Adventures . There are currently 64 volumes in total. To date, 63 volumes have been released in North America by VIZ Media; the first 41 volumes were released in Singapore by Chuang Yi, with Shogakukan Asia picking up publication thereafter, currently with 10 volumes released. VIZ Media's first edition of - gave each volume its own title, like "Desperado Pikachu" for Volume 1.

Starting in July 2018, VIZ Media began releasing these volumes in a digital format by releasing sets of volumes by arc. This was completed on December 25, 2018. Afterwards, the later volumes would be released alongside their trade paperback counterparts.
